compute.basis: No code released; the full RTTAD pipeline (masked autoencoder with dual reconstruction tasks, mask-diversity loss, GMM-thresholded pseudo-label selection, KNN contrastive test-time adaptation with iterative updates) must be reimplemented from the paper, then trained 200 epochs and adapted on the shifted test split; the Wine dataset itself is tiny so runtime is dominated by reimplementation and debugging, not compute.
